_comment: Shared token guarding the public meetrudi-tts Function URL. Create in the console as a plaintext secret named exactly 'meetrudi/tts/token' (region eu-central-1). The rudi-deployer user cannot create secrets, so this is a console step. meetrudi-tts returns 503 on every synthesis request until it exists. Generate the value with: python -c "import secrets;print(secrets.token_hex(24))"
